# 5VA Appliance Repair

> Residential appliance repair with Philadelphia as the primary service area. Pennsylvania and New Jersey requests are confirmed by ZIP code and appliance before booking.

## Business information

- Exact business name: 5VA Appliance Repair
- Phone and SMS: +1 (267) 704-8588
- Mobile service only: visits at customers' homes; no shop, street address or customer drop-off
- Hours: 7 AM–8 PM every day, America/New_York
- Territory: Philadelphia 19115 and 19116, all Montgomery County PA, plus the exact PA/NJ ZIPs listed on /service-areas/
- Services: household refrigerators, washers, dryers, ovens/stoves/cooktops, dishwashers, freezers, microwaves, and ice makers, subject to model assessment
- No appliance sales, no retail parts sales, no commercial equipment repair, and no general home repair services
- [Original Google Business Profile](https://www.google.com/maps?cid=12282828888363558368)
- The initial conversation has no 5VA service charge. Carrier terms may apply. Visit, diagnosis, parts, and repair fees are separate.
- Do not infer guaranteed statewide appointments, same-day service, fixed prices, warranties, licenses, or manufacturer authorization.
